correctness.rationale: The published exact rank-one formula yields \(\omega_q(A)= rac{\|A\|}{2}(1+r	au+\sqrt{1-r^2}\sqrt{1-	au^2})\). Disk containment is exactly \(\omega_q(A)\le r\). Minimizing the denominator term over \(0\le	au\le1\) reduces to the endpoint values \(r\) and \(\sqrt{1-r^2}\); equality cases follow from Cauchy--Schwarz and \(A^2=(\operatorname{tr}A)A\). The boundary values \(r=1\), \(r=2^{-1/2}\), and \(r=4/5\) were checked separately. No finite experiment is used as proof.

value.rationale: Rank one is a canonical extremal class in numerical-range theory, and the exact norm envelope under the focal scaled-disk constraint is a natural invariant. The theorem gives a complete equality classification, reveals a projection-to-square-zero transition at \(|q|=2^{-1/2}\), and identifies exactly when rank-one operators attain the universal dilation coefficient at the separate \(4/5\) threshold.
